title: Trafficking of Minors for Sexual Acts
excerpt: Federal prosecutors established that Epstein engaged in sex trafficking of minors, with multiple victims providing consistent testimony and corroborating evidence including flight logs, financial records, and witness statements.

title: Involvement of Specific Associates in Alleged Activities
excerpt: Multiple civil filings contain allegations that specific individuals participated in or facilitated alleged unlawful activities. These claims remain unadjudicated in criminal court and are contested by named individuals.
caseRef: Giuffre v. Maxwell, 1:15-cv-07433 (S.D.N.Y.); Unsealed Deposition Excerpts, 2019

title: Alleged Activities at Specific Private Residence
excerpt: Certain media reports and unsealed documents reference allegations of activities at a specific private residence. Property owners and named individuals have publicly denied these claims, and no criminal charges have been filed related to this specific location.

title: 2008 Non-Prosecution Agreement (NPA) Terms
excerpt: Federal court findings confirmed the 2008 NPA violated the Crime Victims' Rights Act, though specific terms of the agreement remain a subject of legal review.

title: Alleged Activities at Private Island (Great Saint James)
excerpt: Multiple reports allege unlawful activities at Epstein's private island. While ownership and visits are documented, specific claims regarding activities remain unadjudicated and contested.
